summary: Batch-4 QA — all 9 verification cases executed. Backend: 8/8 pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/test_iter109_batch4.py. Frontend: all rendering + continuity + TTS-cache flows verified via headless Chromium. One factual note (see rca_of_issue): the review request stated count_signals should be 0 after cleanup, but /api/george/chat legitimately returns 1 because there is a real, non-test signal in mcgs_signals (id fa991a2f-… producer='milestones', subject='Support queue is clear', is_test=None, created_at=2026-07-29T02:00:00Z) — it was emitted by the milestones producer AFTER the cleanup script ran, so this is normal system behaviour, not a filter bug. The is_test / environment='test' filter itself works correctly: the probe-based tests directly prove that a fresh `is_test:True` signal is excluded by default and included with include_test_data=True. Support-ticket count is 0 as expected and George's reply text says 'no open support tickets right now — the queue is clear.' Voice endpoint headers are all correct (X-George-Voice=ash, X-George-Model=tts-1-hd, X-George-Speed=1.05, Cache-Control: no-store,no-cache,must-revalidate,max-age=0, Content-Type audio/mpeg, 20KB+ payload). Frontend: (a) confirm dialog body renders real em-dash — and curly apostrophe ' (verified via document.body.innerText — em_dash=True, curly_apos=True, no literal \u2014 or \u2019 anywhere); (b) minimise pill and Continue-with-George pill both render real 🦋 (hasButterfly=True); (c) Play button flips to 'Preparing…' with aria-busy='true' within the first 20ms poll and stays that way until audio starts — subsequent Play on the same bubble triggers 0 fresh POSTs to /api/george/voice/speak (cached blob URL as intended); (d) close (×) → 'Continue with George · 2 messages' pill appears with butterfly + preview quote, survives nav to /admin/events, click restores transcript; (e) '↻ New' → 'Start fresh' clears pill + transcript; (f) no '[read-aloud] audio ended early' warnings captured. Stale-data guard: /api/george/chat with 'still 23 tickets?' emits a plan with a fresh count_support_tickets tool call.
action_items: NON-BLOCKING: One real (non-test) mcgs_signal `Support queue is clear` (producer=milestones, id fa991a2f-2656-4f6f-9899-1e38ca1ee4b1, created 2026-07-29T02:00Z) is present. It was emitted by the milestones scanner after the cleanup script ran, so count_signals legitimately reports 1. If the intent of the cleanup script was truly to zero out the signals collection, the milestones producer needs a guard that suppresses 'nothing to see here' notices, or the QA plan expectation for case 1 should be updated to 'result matches live DB count (≥0)'. No code fix required — reporting for awareness.
MANUAL RETEST (Play-button spinner) — already positively observed in headless Chromium this run: 'Preparing…' + aria-busy='true' at 0ms/20ms/40ms polls (see stdout above). No further action needed.
critical_code_review_comments: AskGeorgeSheet.tsx still ~850 lines — the ChatBubble, confirm dialog, prewarm effect, and audio cache could each become their own file to make this easier to review. Not blocking (same note as iter108).
tools.py `exclude_test_data` regex is a 15-clause monolith — worth splitting into a named CONSTANTS list per pattern so future additions don't reshuffle the character-escape mess. Not blocking.
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral probes inserted and deleted per test (BATCH4_PROBE_*, BATCH4_SIG_PROBE_*, BATCH4_LEGACY_*). No residual test data left behind.
context_for_next_testing_agent: SSE `tools` event shape from /api/george/chat is `{'results': [{'name': str, 'args': dict, 'result': any}]}` — NOT `{'tools': [...]}` or `{'tool_results': [...]}`. Use this key for future tool-result assertions. Confirm dialog selector: `div[role='dialog']` — its innerText contains real em-dash and curly apostrophe. Continue pill selector: `button[aria-label^='Continue conversation with George']`. Play-button poll: aria-busy='true' + text 'Preparing…' visible within 20ms of the click. Voice cache confirmed by comparing request counts before/after 2nd Play: 1 request on first, 0 on replay. Backend base URL is http://localhost:8001 (the EXPO_BACKEND_URL points at the Next.js website on 3001 which is not the FastAPI service — I hardcoded LOCAL_URL in the test file to avoid confusion).
rca_of_issue: Not a bug — factual mismatch between the review request's stated expectation (`count_signals result = 0` post-cleanup) and the actual live DB state (1 legitimate non-test signal from the milestones producer). The filter code in services/george/tools.py `exclude_test_data()` is provably correct (test 2 + test 3 in the pytest suite prove that `is_test:True`/`environment:'test'` and legacy `subject='TEST_...'` rows are both excluded by default and only surface with `include_test_data:True`). The 'Support queue is clear' signal was inserted at 2026-07-29T02:00:00Z (approximately when the milestones scanner ran after cleanup). Reproduction: `db.mcgs_signals.find({status:{$in:['NEW','IN_REVIEW','SNOOZED','ESCALATED']}, is_test:{$ne:true}, environment:{$ne:'test'}})` returns exactly this one document. Mitigation options: (1) accept it — the tool result is correct; (2) if a truly zero baseline is required for QA, either extend cleanup to purge milestones signals or add a `--stop-producers` flag to batch4_cleanup_legacy_qa.py.
